stratification.edge_strategy: quintiles over full PopQA o_pop distribution

schema_mapping.question: PopQA.question (Wikidata-templated)
schema_mapping.cutoff_class: literal string 'external' (PopQA has no cutoff structure)

caveats: PopQA is templated from Wikidata, so it does not fully escape the surface-form concern in Phase 1. Value: independent construction + real continuous popularity signal + different distribution.
PopQA has no cutoff structure (mostly static facts); the cutoff/correctness disconfound does NOT apply. Every item is marked cutoff_class='external'.
PopQA questions are mostly answerable, so refusals are expected to be rare. The refusal-vs-wrong probe will only be run on the PopQA sample if at least 30 refusals appear.
